body:
[A10] Ruling on processor #61/#83 (lane P1, [A515]'s STOP 5967588719): the **integrator owns the channel maps' persistence**, the same pattern as the 2026-09-19 owner decision on counters.

The map plane lives in the parent (`milan_datapath.sv`, `KL_chan_map_capture.sv`), and its records `0x60`/`0x70` are already allocated in the saved-state census and copied at capture. The processor keeps the ATDECC side of the maps (SET/ADD/REMOVE_AUDIO_MAPPINGS, GET_AUDIO_MAP). It no longer owns their restore or roll-back. The roll-back strobe is not a top-level output, and adding one would cost area against the owner's 2026-10-03 area-first decision.

## Acceptance

1. The parent restores the maps from records `0x60`/`0x70` at boot, under the same D3 rules as the processor's records (well-formed only; a torn or corrupt record keeps the default), and resets them on a roll-back.
2. The saved-state contract and design pages state the ownership. The processor's amended D3 contract (lane P1) matches.
3. A parent check plants a power cycle after a map change and proves the maps return. A torn-record control keeps the default.
4. The capture timing and census are unchanged, or re-measured.

Relates to #70 (saved state).
